_: BOOTPROOF-1: every secret a seed workflow reads, with how it degrades and how code acquires it.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.degrade: seed runs without it: deploys route through the platform OIDC endpoint
CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.acquire: bootstrap stage provision reads it from the platform connect flow

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.degrade: deploy goes through the platform site worker OIDC route
CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.acquire: connect flow mints a scoped token (POINT-AND-CLICK-1)

DASHBOARD_URL.acquire: set by the bootstrap org stage from the deployed Worker url

FLEET_TOKEN.acquire: tick Worker GitHub App mints a repo token

LANE_PAT.acquire: tick Worker GitHub App main writer

ORG_ADMIN_TOKEN.degrade: repo-settings route through the administration App

_grandfather: shrink-only: 0010 was applied twice-named in live seed databases, renaming would re-run it
